paragraphs.chinese:
这一集刚好是 Phil 的生日，同时也是第一代 iPad 正式开卖的日子。对 Phil 来说，这差不多已经是一个宗教节日了。

他本来打算一早去店外排队，可 Claire 不想让他生日当天大半时间都站在队伍里，于是主动说自己替他去买。这个想法很甜，执行却惨不忍睹。Claire 早上确实起床了，只是坐到沙发上休息了一下，然后直接睡着。等她赶到店里，iPad 已经全部卖光。

Phil 嘴上装作无所谓，实际上显然在意得要命。Claire 更难受，因为这一次她真的以为自己找到了一个绝对完美的礼物。她赶紧让孩子们也一起到处找，看哪里还能弄到一台。

Phil 为了让自己开心一点，去了打击练习场。那里刚好有人办生日派对，他有那么一瞬间以为 Claire 给自己准备了惊喜。然后才发现，寿星只是另一个也叫 Phil 的小男孩。到这里他基本已经彻底放弃这个生日了，直接回家。

Claire 还是没找到 iPad，可 Luke 竟然搞定了，而且用的是最 Luke 的方式。他用 Phil 的电脑联系了一些科技宅朋友，告诉他们自己爸爸快死了，临终愿望就是拥有一台 iPad。真有一个人被感动了，拿了一台多买的送过来。Claire 大概震惊了半秒钟，然后直接夸 Luke 是个“漂亮的小骗子”。Phil 一看到 iPad，之前那些“我根本不在乎”的表演立刻全部消失，开心得像疯了一样。

与此同时，Jay 送了 Phil 一套国际象棋，先拿 Manny 来试棋。Jay 认定 Manny 根本不会下，于是 Gloria 偷偷让 Manny 故意输给他。Manny 照做了，可 Jay 赢了以后越来越烦人，一直给 Manny 讲基本走法，好像真在教一个完全不会下棋的小孩。

Manny 最后受不了了，直接提出再来一盘，还把 Jay 的手表当赌注。这次他不装了，四步就把 Jay 将死。

Jay 又去找 Gloria 下，想把面子赢回来。结果 Gloria 的棋力也远比他想象得强，很快就走到一个明显能赢的位置。可她没有走最后一步，而是停下来承认，自己平时经常故意让 Jay 赢，因为他输不起。Jay 很不爽，但也聪明到没有坚持把这盘棋下完。

在 Mitchell 和 Cameron 家，两个人从 Lily 的婴儿监听器里听见一个陌生男人的声音，以为家里进了人。Cameron 马上冲去保护 Lily，Mitchell 却整个人僵住。最后才发现，监听器串到了邻居家的信号。

Cameron 继续偷听，还发现隔壁那对夫妻正因为一个误会快要分手。他跑过去把事情解释清楚，觉得自己简直拯救了一段婚姻。结果对方很快反应过来，他之所以知道这些，是因为一直在听别人家的私密对话，于是开始叫他变态。

Phil 最后拿到了自己最想要的生日礼物；Jay 一天之内被 Manny 和 Gloria 连续教育；Cameron 则发现，想帮助邻居没问题，但如果起点是偷听，事情就会立刻变得很奇怪。
paragraphs.english:
This episode takes place on Phil’s birthday, which is also the day the first iPad goes on sale. To Phil, this is basically a religious event.

He plans to wake up early and wait outside the store, but Claire tells him not to spend his birthday in line. She promises she’ll get the iPad instead. The plan is sweet. The execution is terrible. Claire gets up early, sits down for a second, falls asleep on the couch, and wakes up too late. By the time she reaches the store, the iPads are gone.

Phil tries to act like it doesn’t matter, but it obviously does. Claire feels awful because for once she was sure she had found the perfect gift. She gets the kids to help her look for one somewhere else.

Phil goes to the batting cages to cheer himself up. He sees a birthday party and briefly thinks Claire has arranged a surprise for him. Then he realizes the party is for a little boy who is also named Phil. After that, he basically gives up on the day and goes home.

Claire still has nothing. Luke, however, solves the problem in the most Luke way possible. He uses Phil’s computer to contact some of his tech friends, tells them his father is dying, and says Phil’s last wish is an iPad. One guy feels so bad that he brings over an extra one. Claire is horrified for about half a second, then calls Luke a beautiful little liar. When Phil sees the iPad, he is ridiculously happy.

Meanwhile, Jay gives Phil a chess set and tries it out with Manny. Jay assumes Manny barely knows how to play, so Gloria secretly tells Manny to let him win. Manny does, but Jay becomes unbearable, giving him advice and explaining basic moves like he’s teaching a child.

Manny finally gets sick of it and challenges Jay again, this time with Jay’s watch on the line. He stops pretending and beats Jay in four moves.

Jay then plays Gloria, expecting to restore his pride. Gloria is much better than he thinks and reaches a position where she can clearly win. Instead of finishing, she stops and admits she often lets Jay win because he’s a terrible loser. Jay is annoyed, but smart enough not to finish the game.

At Mitchell and Cameron’s house, they hear a strange man’s voice through Lily’s baby monitor and think someone is inside. Cameron runs to Lily while Mitchell freezes. It turns out the monitor is picking up the neighbors.

Cameron keeps listening and realizes the couple next door are about to break up over a misunderstanding. He goes over and clears it up, feeling like he saved their marriage. Then they realize he has been listening to their private conversations and start calling him a creep.

Phil gets exactly what he wanted, Jay gets humbled twice, and Cameron learns that helping your neighbors gets strange when you start by spying on them.
